title: Your Home Insurance Is Missing $63,000 After a Claim
hook: You've been paying home insurance for years — but a single hidden word in your policy could leave you $63,000 short when you need it most.
angle: Most homeowners don't know the difference between ACV and RCV policies — and find out only after disaster strikes and the check is half what they expected.
audience: Homeowners and renters who assume their insurance fully replaces what they own
